$ orion-agent config show

=== config edit
$ orion-agent config edit

   ✓ Opened in $EDITOR
   ✓ Valid

 Review
   @@ monitors.redis @@
   - port: 6379
   + port: 6380
   @@ logs @@
   + key_file: /etc/orion/nginx.key

 ┃ Save and reload the running agent?
    Save     Edit again     Discard

=== validate and diff
$ orion-agent config validate

 ERROR  Invalid config
   /etc/orion/config.yaml:14:3  unknown key "intervall"  did you mean interval?

$ orion-agent config diff

 against base file only
   - core_url: https://old.example.com
   + core_url: https://core.example.com

   ✓ 1 change from the drop-in and environment

--- notes
NOTE Show it like a tree: Settings with where each came from as a small chip: file, drop-in or env. Answers why is it set to this?
NOTE Edit, review, save: Opens your editor, validates, shows a diff with tinted lines, then asks once. The running agent reloads.
NOTE Errors point at the line: Same code-frame error as everywhere, with a suggestion.
NOTE Plain diff in scripts: Piped output is a normal unified diff.
